>>   Select-String -Pattern 'function createSmartConfig|export function createSmartConfig' -Context 0,150

> export function createSmartConfig(targetPath, options) {
      const projectType = options?.projectType || detectProjectType(targetPath);
      const excludes = [...getDefaultExcludes(projectType), ...(options?.customExcludes || [])];
      console.error(`[createSmartConfig] Detected project type: ${projectType}`);
      const config = {
          options: {
              enableSecrets: options?.scanSecrets,
              thirdParty: options?.scanThirdParty
          },
          targets: []
      };
      // Configure based on project type
      switch (projectType) {
          case 'java-maven':
          case 'java-gradle':
          case 'java-ear':
          case 'java-war':
          case 'java-jar': {
              const jdkPath = findJdkPath();
              const jspCompiler = findJspCompiler(targetPath);
              const customBuildInfo = {};
              if (jdkPath) {
                  customBuildInfo.jdk_path = jdkPath;
                  console.error(`[createSmartConfig] Found JDK: ${jdkPath}`);
              }
              if (jspCompiler && (projectType === 'java-war' || projectType === 'java-ear')) {
                  customBuildInfo.jsp_compiler = jspCompiler;
                  console.error(`[createSmartConfig] Found JSP compiler: ${jspCompiler}`);
              }
              // For Maven/Gradle, detect additional classpaths
              if (projectType === 'java-maven' || projectType === 'java-gradle') {
                  const libDirs = [];
                  const stat = fs.statSync(targetPath);
                  if (stat.isDirectory()) {
                      const potentialLibs = ['lib', 'libs', 'target/dependency', 'build/libs'];
                      for (const lib of potentialLibs) {
                          const libPath = path.join(targetPath, lib);
                          if (fs.existsSync(libPath)) {
                              libDirs.push(libPath);
                          }
                      }
                  }
                  if (libDirs.length > 0) {
                      const separator = process.platform === 'win32' ? ';' : ':';
                      customBuildInfo.additional_classpath = libDirs.join(separator);
                      console.error(`[createSmartConfig] Found additional classpaths: ${customBuildInfo.additional_classpath}`);
                  }
              }
              config.targets.push({
                  path: targetPath,
                  customBuildInfo: Object.keys(customBuildInfo).length > 0 ? customBuildInfo : undefined,
                  include: options?.customIncludes,
                  exclude: excludes
              });
              break;
          }
          case 'dotnet-solution':
          case 'dotnet-project': {
              const customBuildInfo = {
                  configuration: 'Release' // Default to Release build
              };
              // Try to find packages directory for references
              const stat = fs.statSync(targetPath);
              const baseDir = stat.isDirectory() ? targetPath : path.dirname(targetPath);
              const packagesDir = path.join(baseDir, 'packages');
              if (fs.existsSync(packagesDir)) {
                  const packages = fs.readdirSync(packagesDir)
                      .filter(p => fs.statSync(path.join(packagesDir, p)).isDirectory())
                      .map(p => path.join(packagesDir, p, '**', '*.dll'));
                  if (packages.length > 0) {
                      customBuildInfo.references = packages.join(';');
                      console.error(`[createSmartConfig] Found package references`);
                  }
              }
              config.targets.push({
                  path: targetPath,
                  customBuildInfo,
                  include: options?.customIncludes,
                  exclude: excludes
              });
              break;
          }
          case 'cpp-solution': {
              const customBuildInfo = {
                  configuration: 'Release' // Default to Release build
              };
              config.targets.push({
                  path: targetPath,
                  customBuildInfo,
                  include: options?.customIncludes,
                  exclude: excludes
              });
              break;
          }
          default: {
              // For directory scans or unknown types, use simple configuration
              config.targets.push({
                  path: targetPath,
                  outputsOnly: projectType === 'directory', // Treat as output directory
                  include: options?.customIncludes,
                  exclude: excludes
              });
              break;
          }
      }
      return config;
  }
  //# sourceMappingURL=create-appscan-config.js.map
